_comment: Sources for fetching each teammate's checkpoint. Fill in 'source' for the bots that aren't in the repo yet, then run: python -m rlbot.tournament.download. 'type' is one of: url (zip/tar archive over http[s]), git (repo URL, optionally '<url>#<subdir>'), local (path on this machine to copy). Entries with an empty 'source' are skipped. Bots already in the repo (diego/martin/marian) are listed for reference with empty sources.

nachi.note: ask Nachi for a zip/drive link or git repo of his checkpoint folder (PPO_POLICY.pt + BOOK_KEEPING_VARS.json)

marco.note: ask Marco for a zip/drive link or git repo of his checkpoint folder (PPO_POLICY.pt + BOOK_KEEPING_VARS.json)
